messages.content: Extract the invoice. Follow this schema: {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"invoice_id": {"pattern": "^INV-[0-9]{4}$", "title": "Invoice Id", "type": "string"}, "amount": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "title": "Amount", "type": "number"}, "currency": {"enum": ["CAD", "USD"], "title": "Currency", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["invoice_id", "amount", "currency"], "title": "InvoicePayload", "type": "object"}
